songs.name: Beat It On Down The Line

ai_show_review.summary: Epic Dark Star → Other One → Lovelight marathon with tight acoustic start
ai_show_review.blurb: The early‑show kicks off with a relaxed Bear's Choice‑style acoustic set that rolls into an electric half hour of nonstop groove. Standout moments include the all‑time Dark Star → The Other One → Lovelight stretch and fiery renditions of Good Lovin', Black Peter, Hard To Handle and Saint Stephen.
ai_show_review.review: February 13, 1970 at the Fillmore East captures the Dead in a rare moment of pure forward momentum. After an intimate acoustic opening that feels like a private rehearsal of Bear's Choice material, the band erupts into a high‑octane electric set. Jerry’s tone is immaculate as he steers an all‑time Dark Star into a marathon Other One and culminates with a joyous Lovelight finale – a sequence reviewers call "legendary" and "mind‑bending." The rhythm section never quits: Phil’s bass riffs lock in tightly, Bob drives the high‑energy Other One with fierce rhythm chops, and the dual drums of Mickey and Bill keep a propulsive pulse through Good Lovin', Hard To Handle and Saint Stephen. The show closes on a heartfelt Casey Jones that leaves the audience buzzing. With crystal‑clear Miller‑fixed soundboard sources, this early Fillmore run stands out as one of the band’s most exhilarating pre‑Europe nights.

best_recording.reason: Miller‑fixed soundboard transfer is crisp, brilliant and captures the full show without dropouts, delivering the clearest representation of the legendary jams.

key_highlights: Legendary Dark Star → The Other One → Lovelight marathon
Tight acoustic Bear's Choice opening that builds into high‑energy electric set
Fire‑breathing renditions of Good Lovin', Black Peter, Hard To Handle and Saint Stephen
Solid rhythm foundation from Mickey, Bill, Phil and Bob throughout

band_performance.Jerry: Delivers soaring tone and inventive improvisation, especially on the extended Dark Star/Other One/Lovelight sequence.
band_performance.Phil: Locks in with strutting riffs early on and provides a tight, propulsive bass foundation throughout the set.
band_performance.Bob: Drives the high‑energy Other One with powerful rhythm guitar work and adds gritty texture to the electric numbers.
band_performance.Mickey: Keeps a steady, dynamic pulse that underpins the band's jam flow.
band_performance.Billy: Pairs with Mickey for a tight, swinging drum sound that fuels the show's relentless energy.
